title: Compact profiles, anchored filter bar, and KV-aware row prefetch for virtual tables
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current virtualized table offers a single density setting and a floating filter row which disappears when users navigate large datasets. Customers have requested denser compact views for high-cardinality lists, a persistent filter affordance for repeated queries, and fewer perceived stalls when scrolling long tables. Engineering also wants hints to improve prefetching (KV-aware row prefetch) so the serving side can warm row render data without increasing latency.

Goal: Deliver a cohesive design system update that introduces: compact density profiles (Compact, Compact+, Ultra-Compact), an anchored filter bar that persists at top of viewport with progressive reveal, and a set of micro-interactions and telemetry to enable KV-aware prefetch signals to the runtime. The UX must be keyboard and screen-reader accessible, maintainable in the component library, and allow gradual rollout via the Console's feature flags.

Constraints and non-goals: Do not change the underlying virtualization library API in this ticket. Keep performance overhead minimal for default users. This ticket covers visual/interaction design, tokens, and necessary spec for engineering to implement prefetch hints; the runtime changes are tracked in ENG-2871.

Primary users: Product and power-users browsing tens of thousands of rows (support teams, platform engineers, data managers) who prefer keyboard-first interactions and need quick repeated filters.

Acceptance criteria:
- Design tokens and variants created for three compact density profiles with clear token mapping to spacing and font-size values.
- Anchored filter bar visual spec (collapsed/expanded states) with keyboard focus behavior, close/clear affordances, and ARIA attributes documented.
- Interaction spec for column resizing in compact profiles that includes a reduced handle target but preserves keyboard accessibility.
- Heatmap overlay mock that shows predicted column usage and recommended default column widths for small screens.
- A minimal telemetry contract (events and payload) to support KV-aware row prefetch: resize.interaction, density.change, filter.anchor.toggle, scroll.prefetch.hint.
- Prototype (Figma + interactive) validating scroll persistence and keyboard flows.
- Design handoff assets (token mapping, CSS vars, interaction motion specs) uploaded to design system repo.

Success metrics: Reduced filter re-entry time for recurring queries (qualitative), decreased perceived scroll jank in compact views in our UX sessions, and engineering confirms prefetch hints reduce first-paint time for warmed rows in the 95th percentile (measured in ENG-2871 rollout).
